messages:
sam: Quick heads-up 1: noticed atlas-13k-int4v2 misbehaving during quant bring-up. Long system preamble + many tiny user turns -> model abruptly loses coherence around token ~9k, answers truncate into short, unrelated sentences.

sam: Happens only with dynamic-tiling + quant-backend=v2. static-tiling and v1 backend look fine.

tori: Do you have a minimal repro? Any kv diagnostics?

sam: Minimal repro attached (below). Ran on ci/gpu-4. I enabled kv_patient_dump.

# repro snippet
from rwclient import Redwood
cli = Redwood(model='atlas-13k-int4v2')
ctx = 'SYS:\\n' + 'X'*8800 + '\\n'
for i in range(120):
    ctx += f'u{i}: why?\\n'
res = cli.generate(ctx, max_tokens=600, kv_inspect=True)
print(res.text)

ish: I pulled the kv dump. There's a non-contiguous deletion: indices 22736..24783 absent, everything before and after present. Gap size 2048.

chris: That matches a tiling_stride=2048 eviction. Any compaction/gc events logged at the same time?

ish: Log extract: \n[2026-03-04T09:12:03Z] compactor: try_compact -> selected_stride=2048\n[2026-03-04T09:12:03Z] quant_gc: finalize_free(keep=8192)\n[2026-03-04T09:12:03Z] kv_index: apply_compaction(removed=2048)\nNo explicit caller says "early-evict".

tori: Could be the compaction choosing a stride based on the wrong reference window. We recently changed compaction heuristic in PR #6890 (reduce watermark for int4 lanes).

sam: When I ran the repro with the branch before PR #6890 the gap disappears and generation remains coherent beyond 12k.

chris: Two hypotheses: 1) compaction is using an off-by-one base when computing absolute indices when tiles are partially filled, or 2) quant backend finalizer races with compaction and frees a buffer before the stitcher rewrites indices.

ish: Also saw RoPE phase misalignment across the hole boundary: pos_emb at idx 22735 vs 24784 differ by a small phase that shouldn't exist if indices were continuous. That would explain semantic drift.

ci-bot: ci job 7854 started (gpu-4) for bisect-run.

tori: Plan: revert the compaction watermark in the int4 path temporarily, add an assert in the stitcher to check monotonic kv_index_map and a post-compact diagnostic dump that includes pos_scale and tile_offsets. If assert fails, capture full kv raw pages.

chris: I'll draft the patch. Add unit test that simulates partially filled tail tiles then triggers compaction. Expect no index holes.

sam: Please also consider a hotfix canary for dedicated clusters; this will impact customers relying on long priming.

ish: I'll run a longer fuzz overnight against dynamic-tiling + int4v2 with injected timing jitter to catch races.

tori: Thanks. Uploading failed traces + kv dumps to s3: s3://redwood-ci/qa/atlas-13k/3333333333/kvhole.tar.gz

sam: Great. Will monitor the canary and update here. :eyes:
